questions.question: Why do bread becomes rough and dry on storage?
questions.solution_html:
• Bread becomes rough and dry due to starch retrogradation, where gelatinized starch
  • recrystallizes over time, leading to moisture redistribution and firm texture (staling).
questions.final_answer: Bread becomes rough and dry due to starch retrogradation, where gelatinized starch
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How do proteins act as emulsifying agents in food systems?
questions.solution_html:
• Proteins contain both hydrophilic and hydrophobic groups, allowing them to adsorb at the
  • oil–water interface, reduce interfacial tension, and stabilize emulsions.
questions.final_answer: Proteins contain both hydrophilic and hydrophobic groups, allowing them to adsorb at the

questions.question: Define caustic refining
questions.solution_html:
• Caustic refining is the process of treating crude oils with alkali (NaOH) to remove free fatty
  • acids, phospholipids, and other impurities.

questions.question: What are non starch polysaccharides? Give it's application in food.
questions.solution_html:
• Non-starch polysaccharides are complex carbohydrates other than starch, such as cellulose
  • hemicellulose, pectin, and gums.Applications: act as dietary fiber, thickening agents, stabilizers
  • and gelling agents (e.g., pectin in jam).
questions.final_answer: and gelling agents (e.g., pectin in jam)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the effect of temperature, pH, metal ions and oxygen on enzymatic browning.
questions.solution_html:
•  Temperature: increases enzyme activity up to optimum, then denatures enzyme
  •  pH: acidic pH inhibits enzyme activity
  •  Metal ions: Cu²⁺ activates polyphenol oxidase
  •  Oxygen: essential for oxidation reactions leading to browning
questions.final_answer:  Oxygen: essential for oxidation reactions leading to browning
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define rancidity. Discuss about different types of rancidity.
questions.solution_html:
• Rancidity is the deterioration of fats and oils resulting in unpleasant odor and taste.
  • Types
  •  Oxidative rancidity (reaction with oxygen)
  •  Hydrolytic rancidity (lipase activity)
  •  ketonic rancidity
questions.final_answer:  ketonic rancidity
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the different methods and products of starch hydrolysis and its important applications in food.
questions.solution_html:
• applications in food.
  • Methods
  •  Acid hydrolysis
  •  Enzymatic hydrolysis (α-amylase, β-amylase, glucoamylase)
  • Products:Glucose, Maltose, Dextrins and High fructose corn syrup
  • Applications
  •  Sweeteners
  •  Brewing industry
  •  Bakery products
  •  Thickening agents
questions.final_answer:  Thickening agents
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define amylase enzymes and explain its types along with its functions.
questions.solution_html:
• Amylases are enzymes that hydrolyze starch into simpler sugars.
  • Types
  •  α-amylase: breaks internal α-1,4 bonds
  •  β-amylase: releases maltose from ends
  •  Glucoamylase: produces glucose
  • Functions:Used in the digestion, brewing, baking, and starch processing industries.
questions.final_answer: Functions:Used in the digestion, brewing, baking, and starch processing industries
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the procedure to determine peroxide value with calculations and discuss it's importance in assessing rancidity.
questions.solution_html:
• importance in assessing rancidity.
  • Procedure
  •  React fat sample with potassium iodide
  •  Liberated iodine titrated with sodium thiosulfate
  • Calculation
  • Peroxide value = (S - B) × N × 1000 W
  • Importance
  • Indicates extent of oxidative rancidity and quality of fats.
questions.final_answer: Option (b) × N × 1000 W
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the structure and modifications of cellulose in food products.
questions.solution_html:
• Structure:Cellulose is a linear polymer of β-1,4 linked glucose units forming strong fibers.
  • Modifications:Carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and Microcrystalline cellulose
  • Applications
  • Used as thickener, stabilizer, fat replacer, and dietary fiber in food products.
questions.final_answer: Used as thickener, stabilizer, fat replacer, and dietary fiber in food products
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
